title: Berberine alleviates neuroinflammation by downregulating NFkappaB/LCN2 pathway in sepsis-associated encephalopathy: network pharmacology, bioinformatics, and experimental validation.
authors: Gong, Hailong; Xia, Yun; Jing, Guoqing; Yuan, Min; Zhou, Huimin; Wu, Die; Zuo, Jing; Lei, Chuntian; Aidebaike, Delida; Wu, Xiaojing; Song, Xuemin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱通过NFkappaB/LCN2通路缓解脓毒症相关脑病的神经炎症，涉及分子对接但核心为网络药理学和湿实验验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis refers to a systemic inflammatory response caused by infection, involving multiple organs. Sepsis-associated encephalopathy (SAE), as one of the most common complications in patients with severe sepsis, refers to the diffuse brain dysfunction caused by sepsis without central nervous system infection. However, there is no clear diagnostic criteria and lack of specific diagnostic markers. METHODS: The main active ingredients of coptidis rhizoma(CR) were identified from TCMSP and SwissADME databases. SwissTargetPrediction and PharmMapper databases were used to obtain targets of CR. OMIM, DisGeNET and Genecards databases were used to explore targets of SAE. Limma differential analysis was used to identify the differential expressed genes(DEGs) in GSE167610 and GSE198861 datasets. WGCNA was used to identify feature module. GO and KEGG enrichment analysis were performed using Metascape, DAVID and STRING databases. The PPI network was constructed by STRING database and analyzed by Cytoscape software. AutoDock and PyMOL software were used for molecular docking and visualization. Cecal ligation and puncture(CLP) was used to construct a mouse model of SAE, and the core targets were verified in vivo experiments. RESULTS: 277 common targets were identified by taking the intersection of 4730 targets related to SAE and 509 targets of 9 main active ingredients of CR. 52 common DEGs were mined from GSE167610 and GSE198861 datasets. Among the 25,864 DEGs in GSE198861, LCN2 showed the most significant difference (logFC = 6.9). GO and KEGG enrichment analysis showed that these 52 DEGs were closely related to "inflammatory response" and "innate immunity". A network containing 38 genes was obtained by PPI analysis, among which LCN2 ranked the first in Degree value. Molecular docking results showed that berberine had a well binding affinity with LCN2. Animal experiments results showed that berberine could inhibit the high expression of LCN2,S100A9 and TGM2 induced by CLP in the hippocampus of mice, as well as the high expression of inflammatory factors (TNFalpha, IL-6 and IL-1beta). In addition, berberine might reduce inflammation and neuronal cell death by partially inhibiting NFkappaB/LCN2 pathway in the hippocampus of CLP models, thereby alleviating SAE. CONCLUSION: Overall, Berberine may exert anti-inflammatory effects through multi-ingredients, multi-targets and multi-pathways to partially rescue neuronal death and alleviate SAE.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症是指由感染引起的全身性炎症反应，涉及多个器官。脓毒症相关性脑病（SAE）作为严重脓毒症患者中最常见的并发症之一，是指由脓毒症引起的弥漫性脑功能障碍，且无中枢神经系统感染。然而，目前尚无明确的诊断标准，且缺乏特异性诊断标志物。方法：从TCMSP和SwissADME数据库中鉴定黄连（CR）的主要活性成分。使用SwissTargetPrediction和PharmMapper数据库获取CR的靶点。利用OMIM、DisGeNET和Genecards数据库探索SAE的靶点。采用Limma差异分析识别GSE167610和GSE198861数据集中的差异表达基因（DEGs）。使用WGCNA识别特征模块。利用Metascape、DAVID和STRING数据库进行GO和KEGG富集分析。通过STRING数据库构建PPI网络，并使用Cytoscape软件进行分析。使用AutoDock和PyMOL软件进行分子对接和可视化。采用盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）构建SAE小鼠模型，并在体内实验中验证核心靶点。结果：通过取4730个与SAE相关的靶点和509个CR的9种主要活性成分靶点的交集，鉴定出277个共同靶点。从GSE167610和GSE198861数据集中挖掘出52个共同DEGs。在GSE198861的25,864个DEGs中，LCN2显示出最显著差异（logFC = 6.9）。GO和KEGG富集分析显示，这52个DEGs与“炎症反应”和“先天免疫”密切相关。通过PPI分析获得一个包含38个基因的网络，其中LCN2的Degree值排名第一。分子对接结果显示，小檗碱与LCN2具有良好的结合亲和力。动物实验结果表明，小檗碱能抑制CLP诱导的小鼠海马中LCN2、S100A9和TGM2的高表达，以及炎症因子（TNFα、IL-6和IL-1β）的高表达。此外，小檗碱可能通过部分抑制CLP模型小鼠海马中的NFκB/LCN2通路来减轻炎症和神经元细胞死亡，从而缓解SAE。结论：总体而言，小檗碱可能通过多成分、多靶点和多通路发挥抗炎作用，部分挽救神经元死亡并缓解SAE。
